verses.en: Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.
verses.pt: Dá ouvidos, ó Deus, à minha oração, e não te escondas da minha súplica.
verses.en_web: Listen to my prayer, God. Don’t hide yourself from my supplication.
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker, on Neginoth. Maschil. Of David.> Give hearing to my prayer, O God; and let not your ear be shut against my request.

verses.en: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;
verses.pt: Atende-me, e ouve-me; agitado estou, e ando perplexo,
verses.en_web: Attend to me, and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and moan,
verses.en_bbe: Give thought to me, and let my prayer be answered: I have been made low in sorrow;

verses.en: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.
verses.pt: por causa do clamor do inimigo e da opressão do ímpio; pois lançam sobre mim iniqüidade, e com furor me perseguem.
verses.en_web: Because of the voice of the enemy, Because of the oppression of the wicked. For they bring suffering on me. In anger they hold a grudge against me.
verses.en_bbe: I am troubled because of the voice of the cruel ones, because of the loud cry of the evil-doers; for they put a weight of evil on me, and they are cruel in their hate for me.

verses.en: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.
verses.pt: O meu coração confrange-se dentro de mim, e terrores de morte sobre mim caíram.
verses.en_web: My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me.
verses.en_bbe: My heart is deeply wounded, and the fear of death has come on me.

verses.en: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.
verses.pt: Temor e tremor me sobrevêm, e o horror me envolveu.
verses.en_web: Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me.
verses.en_bbe: Fear and shaking have come over me, with deep fear I am covered.

verses.en: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then would I fly away, and be at rest.
verses.pt: Pelo que eu disse: Ah! quem me dera asas como de pomba! então voaria, e encontraria descanso.
verses.en_web: I said, “Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest.
verses.en_bbe: And I said, If only I had wings like a dove! for then I would go in flight from here and be at rest.

verses.en: Lo, then would I wander far off, and remain in the wilderness. Selah.
verses.pt: Eis que eu fugiria para longe, e pernoitaria no deserto.
verses.en_web: Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness.” Selah.
verses.en_bbe: I would go wandering far away, living in the waste land. (Selah.)

verses.en: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.
verses.pt: Apressar-me-ia a abrigar-me da fúria do vento e da tempestade.
verses.en_web: “I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm.”
verses.en_bbe: I would quickly take cover from the driving storm and from the violent wind.

verses.en: Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
verses.pt: Destrói, Senhor, confunde as suas línguas, pois vejo violência e contenda na cidade.
verses.en_web: Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
verses.en_bbe: Send destruction on them, O Lord, make a division of tongues among them: for I have seen fighting and violent acts in the town.

verses.en: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow are in the midst of it.
verses.pt: Dia e noite andam ao redor dela, sobre os seus muros; também iniqüidade e malícia estão no meio dela.
verses.en_web: Day and night they prowl around on its walls. Malice and abuse are also within her.
verses.en_bbe: By day and night they go round the town, on the walls; trouble and sorrow are in the heart of it.

verses.en: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.
verses.pt: Há destruição lá dentro; opressão e fraude não se apartam das suas ruas.
verses.en_web: Destructive forces are within her. Threats and lies don’t depart from her streets.
verses.en_bbe: Evil is there; cruel rule and deceit are ever in the streets.

verses.en: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it: neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:
verses.pt: Pois não é um inimigo que me afronta, então eu poderia suportá-lo; nem é um adversário que se exalta contra mim, porque dele poderia esconder-me;
verses.en_web: For it was not an enemy who insulted me, then I could have endured it. Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me, then I would have hidden myself from him.
verses.en_bbe: For it was not my hater who said evil of me; that would have been no grief to me; it was not one outside the number of my friends who made himself strong against me, or I would have kept myself from him in a secret place;

verses.en: But it was thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance.
verses.pt: mas és tu, homem meu igual, meu companheiro e meu amigo íntimo.
verses.en_web: But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend.
verses.en_bbe: But it was you, my equal, my guide, my well-loved friend.

verses.en: We took sweet counsel together, and walked unto the house of God in company.
verses.pt: Conservávamos juntos tranqüilamente, e em companhia andávamos na casa de Deus.
verses.en_web: We took sweet fellowship together. We walked in God’s house with company.
verses.en_bbe: We had loving talk together, and went to the house of God in company.

verses.en: Let death seize upon them, and let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.
verses.pt: A morte os assalte, e vivos desçam ao Seol; porque há maldade na sua morada, no seu próprio íntimo.
verses.en_web: Let death come suddenly on them. Let them go down alive into Sheol. For wickedness is among them, in their dwelling.
verses.en_bbe: Let the hand of death come on them suddenly, and let them go down living into the underworld; because evil is in their houses and in their hearts.

verses.en: As for me, I will call upon God; and the LORD shall save me.
verses.pt: Mas eu invocarei a Deus, e o Senhor me salvará.
verses.en_web: As for me, I will call on God. Yahweh will save me.
verses.en_bbe: As for me, I will make my prayer to God, and he will be my saviour.

verses.en: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.
verses.pt: De tarde, de manhã e ao meio-dia me queixarei e me lamentarei; e ele ouvirá a minha voz.
verses.en_web: Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.
verses.en_bbe: In the evening and in the morning and in the middle of the day I will make my prayer with sounds of grief; and my voice will come to his ears.

verses.en: He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me: for there were many with me.
verses.pt: Livrará em paz a minha vida, de modo que ninguém se aproxime de mim; pois há muitos que contendem contra mim.
verses.en_web: He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, although there are many who oppose me.
verses.en_bbe: He has taken my soul away from the attack which was made against me, and given it peace; for great numbers were against me.

verses.en: God shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not God.
verses.pt: Deus ouvirá; e lhes responderá aquele que está entronizado desde a antigüidade; porque não há neles nenhuma mudança, e tampouco temem a Deus.
verses.en_web: God, who is enthroned forever, will hear, and answer them. Selah. They never change, who don’t fear God.
verses.en_bbe: God will give thought to me; he who from early times is strong will send pain and trouble on them. (Selah.) Because they are unchanged, they have no fear of God.

verses.en: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.
verses.pt: Aquele meu companheiro estendeu a sua mão contra os que tinham paz com ele; violou o seu pacto.
verses.en_web: He raises his hands against his friends. He has violated his covenant.
verses.en_bbe: He has put out his hand against those who were at peace with him; he has not kept his agreement.

verses.en: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.
verses.pt: A sua fala era macia como manteiga, mas no seu coração havia guerra; as suas palavras eram mais brandas do que o azeite, todavia eram espadas desembainhadas.
verses.en_web: His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.
verses.en_bbe: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart; his words were softer than oil, but they were sharp swords.

verses.en: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
verses.pt: Lança o teu fardo sobre o Senhor, e ele te susterá; nunca permitirá que o justo seja abalado.
verses.en_web: Cast your burden on Yahweh, and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
verses.en_bbe: Put your cares on the Lord, and he will be your support; he will not let the upright man be moved.

verses.en: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.
verses.pt: Mas tu, ó Deus, os farás descer ao poço da perdição; homens de sangue e de traição não viverão metade dos seus dias; mas eu em ti confiarei.
verses.en_web: But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days, but I will trust in you.
verses.en_bbe: But you, O God, will send them down into the underworld; the cruel and the false will be cut off before half their days are ended; but I will have faith in you.
